All six syllables and three word groups can be read.
Title remains the first dominant form. Growth is read along letter perimeters and gaps.
Several leaf/letter contacts merge locally in light-color areas, particularly the lower-left flower against 정's final ㅇ.
The complete title remains readable at 213 by 320 pixels.
Fine stem construction is lost at this reduction, while the title and three flower positions remain visible.
At the lower-left, bright petals merge with the cream final ㅇ of 정, reducing local outline distinction.
